QuestInfo.name: [Magatia] A Rose from the Snowfield
QuestInfo.parent: Humanoid Just Wants to be Human
QuestInfo.1:
#p2111003# says it's time for #t4031695# to bloom, but only the hand of a human with a warm heart can pick it. With a sad expression, he asked you to pick the #t4031695# and give it to #b#p2111004##k...\n\nAcquire the #t4000361# to help the #t4031695# bloom, then talk to #b#p2111003# to go to where it was planted#k.

Tip: #t4000361# can be obtained from the #b#o7110301##k.
QuestInfo.2: I gave #p2111004# the #t4031695#. She seemed very surprised by the gesture, followed by a complex look on her face... Will #p2111003#'s love finally bloom as well?

0.0: Hello traveler. I really appreciate all the help you gave me from last time. Thanks to your help, I was able to safely plant #t4031695#. Now I think it's time for it to bloom.
0.1: #t4031695# may be cold, but the flower can only be snapped away with a human's warm hand. If a Humanoid like me touches the flower... it'll break into pieces...
0.2: That is why I am here asking you... to snap #t4031695# away and give this to...#p2111004#.

yes.0: The #t4031695# is such a brittle flower that it can't bloom by itself.\r\nYou'll need to acquire #b#t4000361##k from #bHomunculuses#k, then talk to me. I'll send you to the incubator.\r\nPlace the #b#t4000361##k on the scale, where #t4031696# is asleep. When the flower blooms, pick it and hand it to #r#p2111004##k.
yes.1: Come back and see me once you are ready to grow the rose from the snowfield. I'll take you to the place where it can be grown.

no.0: I understand if you find this too difficult. If I was a human, then I wouldn't have even asked you to do this...

1.0: ...What is it? Is this... a flower? It's #t4031695#... This is a very precious flower. How did you get this? What? It's from #p2111003#?

yes.0: This... is my favorite flower. I just don't know why he'd give me this... #p2111003#... He's a great person, I mean, a great Humanoid, but I already have a husband...

npc.0: Do visit #b#p2111004##k when you have the chance. Please visit her after getting #b#t4031695##k. #t4031695# needs #b#t4000361##k to completely bloom. You can get #t4000361# from #b#o7110301##k.

item.0: What is it? Please don't talk to me unless it's something important.
